items.title: AI memory, storage and optical networking shares rebound broadly after CoreWeave outlook
items.summary: CoreWeave's strong third-quarter results and customer-backed financing narrative triggered a broad recovery across previously battered AI hardware suppliers. Reports published around 9:03-9:08 AM EST showed Sandisk, Seagate, Micron, Coherent and Lumentum up roughly 7-9%, with CoreWeave up about 17% premarket. The move suggests renewed confidence in infrastructure demand but does not confirm durable financing or price recovery.

items.title: Siemens Energy records EUR164bn backlog and lifts power-equipment growth outlook
items.summary: Siemens Energy reported a record €164 billion order backlog, approximately €15 billion of it linked to data centers. It targets 14–16% comparable revenue growth and a 14–16% operating margin before special items in FY2027. Shares rose roughly 7–8% in early European trading; revenue conversion, costs, and an earnings forecast below consensus remain risks.

items.title: Valens Semiconductor exceeds Q3 guidance as automotive connectivity sales grow
items.summary: Valens reported Q3 revenue of $21.9 million, up about 26% year over year and above guidance, with automotive revenue reaching $7.9 million. A reported 6.79% premarket gain followed the release. Its onsemi automotive-camera collaboration supports a growth pathway, but the business remains loss-making and cash balances declined.

items.title: SoftBank reports $7.1bn quarterly loss including $3.7bn U.S. AI data-center equipment charges
items.summary: SoftBank reported a roughly ¥1.12 trillion quarterly loss, including $3.7 billion in charges on prepaid U.S. data-center power equipment after project changes. Its Tokyo shares fell as much as 10.5% on November 11, but recovered to close down 0.44%. The result highlights financing and execution pressure rather than a demonstrated collapse in AI compute demand.

items.title: UKMTO Warning 201-26 reports distinct November 10 tanker projectile strike near Lima, Oman
items.summary: UKMTO Warning 201-26 records a tanker struck by an unidentified projectile 19 nautical miles northeast of Lima, Oman, on November 10 at 13:38 UTC. The master reported the crew safe and no environmental impact, with damage inspection deferred until first light. The vessel, attacker and incremental oil-throughput impact remain unverified; this is distinct from November 7 tanker incidents.
